Subtract the specparam aperiodic component from each fitted spectrum and look at
the oscillatory residual, in two conventions
(`pesco.spectral.remove_aperiodic`):

- **log (flattened)** — $L_{\mathrm{osc}}(f) = \log_{10}\mathrm{PSD}(f) -
  L_{\mathrm{ap}}(f) = \log_{10}(\mathrm{PSD}/\mathrm{PSD}_{\mathrm{ap}})$.
  Dimensionless; zero on the aperiodic fit, positive above it.
- **linear (normalised)** — $\mathrm{PSD}_{\mathrm{osc}}(f) =
  (\mathrm{PSD}(f) - \mathrm{PSD}_{\mathrm{ap}}(f)) / \sum_f \mathrm{PSD}(f)$.
  Linear oscillatory power as a fraction of total power; can dip negative where
  the spectrum falls below the aperiodic fit.

Both are scale-free, so iEEG and source HD-EEG are comparable. Each spectrum is
fit with its BIC-selected aperiodic mode (iEEG knee, HD-EEG fixed); curves are
the per-lobe mean residual across channels.

```{python}
#| label: imports
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from specparam import SpectralGroupModel
from plotnine import (
    aes,
    element_text,
    facet_grid,
    geom_hline,
    geom_line,
    geom_vline,
    ggplot,
    labs,
    scale_color_manual,
    scale_x_log10,
    theme,
    theme_bw,
)

from pesco.spectral import remove_aperiodic
from pesco.experimental.clustering import band_edges
from pesco.bandpower import LOBE_COLORS

PROJECT_DIR = Path("/Users/daniel/PhD/spectral-comparison/code/")
specparam_dir = PROJECT_DIR / "data/interim/specparam_model_selection"
fig_dir = Path("figures/chapter2")
fig_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

FREQ_RANGE = (1.0, 80.0)
SPECPARAM_SETTINGS = dict(  # canonical settings, matching the main results doc
    peak_width_limits=[1, 8],
    max_n_peaks=12,
    min_peak_height=0.1,
    peak_threshold=2.0,
)
SELECTED_MODE = {"iEEG atlas": "knee", "source HD-EEG": "fixed"}
LOBE_ORDER = ["Occipital", "Parietal", "Frontal", "Temporal", "Insula"]
RESID_LABELS = {
    "log": "log  (L_osc = log10 PSD / PSD_ap)",
    "linear": "linear  ((PSD − PSD_ap) / ΣPSD)",
}

INPUT_CSV = {
    "iEEG atlas": specparam_dir / "specparam_input_normalized_psd_ieeg.csv",
    "source HD-EEG": specparam_dir / "specparam_input_normalized_psd_source_hd_eeg.csv",
}
```

```{python}
#| label: compute
def load_psd_csv(path):
    df = pd.read_csv(path, index_col=0)
    num_cols = [c for c in df.columns if str(c).replace(".", "", 1).isdigit()]
    freqs = np.array([float(c) for c in num_cols])
    psd = df[num_cols].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    meta = df[[c for c in df.columns if c not in num_cols]].copy()
    return psd, freqs, meta


def lobe_mean_residual(osc, freqs, lobe, dataset, residual_type):
    """Mean residual spectrum per lobe → long DataFrame (lobe, freq, value)."""
    df = pd.DataFrame(osc, columns=freqs)
    df["Lobe"] = lobe
    long = (
        df.groupby("Lobe").mean().reset_index().melt(
            id_vars="Lobe", var_name="freq", value_name="value"
        )
    )
    long["freq"] = long["freq"].astype(float)
    long["dataset"] = dataset
    long["residual_type"] = RESID_LABELS[residual_type]
    return long


curves = []
for dataset, path in INPUT_CSV.items():
    psd, freqs, meta = load_psd_csv(path)
    lobe = meta["Lobe"].astype(str).str.strip("'").to_numpy()

    fg = SpectralGroupModel(
        **SPECPARAM_SETTINGS, aperiodic_mode=SELECTED_MODE[dataset], verbose=False
    )
    fg.fit(freqs, psd, freq_range=list(FREQ_RANGE), n_jobs=1)

    for residual_type in ("log", "linear"):
        ffreqs, osc = remove_aperiodic(fg, mode=residual_type)
        curves.append(lobe_mean_residual(osc, ffreqs, lobe, dataset, residual_type))

residual_curves = pd.concat(curves, ignore_index=True)
residual_curves["Lobe"] = pd.Categorical(
    residual_curves["Lobe"], categories=LOBE_ORDER, ordered=True
)
residual_curves["dataset"] = pd.Categorical(
    residual_curves["dataset"], categories=["iEEG atlas", "source HD-EEG"], ordered=True
)
residual_curves.to_csv(
    specparam_dir / "aperiodic_residual_lobe_mean_spectra.csv", index=False
)
```

## Per-lobe mean oscillatory residual

```{python}
#| label: fig-residual-spectra
#| output: true
residual_fig = (
    ggplot(residual_curves, aes("freq", "value", color="Lobe"))
    + geom_hline(yintercept=0, color="#bbbbbb", size=0.4)
    + geom_vline(xintercept=band_edges(), linetype="dashed", color="#e6e6e6", size=0.25)
    + geom_line(size=0.8)
    + facet_grid("residual_type ~ dataset", scales="free_y")
    + scale_color_manual(values=LOBE_COLORS, name="lobe")
    + scale_x_log10(breaks=[1, 4, 8, 13, 30, 80])
    + labs(
        x="frequency (Hz)",
        y="oscillatory residual",
        title="Oscillatory residual after aperiodic removal (per-lobe mean)",
    )
    + theme_bw()
    + theme(figure_size=(11, 7), plot_title=element_text(size=11))
)
for ext in ("svg", "pdf", "png"):
    residual_fig.save(
        fig_dir / f"aperiodic_residual_spectra.{ext}",
        width=11, height=7, dpi=150, verbose=False,
    )
residual_fig
```
